newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian palm olein weaker, CPO down.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian palm olein weaker, CPO down.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were weaker in late trading on Wednesday, with a rally in Malaysia failing to excite the local market, traders said.

They said palm olein was quoted at 1,445-55 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, down from 1,450-55 rupiah/kg at the opening, but trades were also heard at 1,440 rupiah. Crude palm oil was done at 1,245 rupiah and 1,247 rupiah at a tender for two consignments of 500 tonnes each in the north Sumatran city of Medan. The previous tender price was 1,271 rupiah/kg.
"Buyers were scare despite the sharp increase in Malaysian prices," one trader said. "They preferred to wait-and-see."
